entities.summary: The Russian Civil War (1918–1922): Red Army vs. White forces, foreign intervention, War Communism, the Red Terror, execution of the Romanov family (July 1918), the Kronstadt Rebellion (1921), the New Economic Policy, and Lenin's death (January 1924).
